functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ai_test_price_microusd(p_prompt_tokens integer, p_output_tokens integer)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select ceil(coalesce(p_prompt_tokens,0) * 0.75 + coalesce(p_output_tokens,0) * 3.75)::bigint;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ai_test_stt_price_microusd(p_audio_bytes bigint, p_transcript_chars integer)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select ceil(
    -- input: seconds x 25 tokens x 3.50 microUSD per token
    (greatest(p_audio_bytes, 0)::numeric / 32000.0) * 25 * 3.50
    -- output: conservative token bound x 21.00 microUSD per token
    + greatest(ceil((greatest(p_audio_bytes, 0)::numeric / 32000.0) / 60.0 * 175), ceil(greatest(p_transcript_chars, 0)::numeric / 2.0)) * 21.00
  )::bigint;
$function$

constraints.definition: CHECK (((settlement_basis = 'AUDIO_DURATION_AT_PUBLISHED_RATE'::text) = ((measured_audio_bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (measured_audio_bytes > 0) AND (measured_transcript_chars IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK ((((settled_microusd IS NULL) AND (settlement_basis IS NULL) AND (settled_at IS NULL)) OR (((settled_microusd >= 0) AND (settled_microusd <= max_cost_microusd)) AND (settlement_basis = ANY (ARRAY['MEASURED'::text, 'CONSERVATIVE_ESTIMATE_UNMEASURED'::text, 'FAILED_NO_USAGE'::text, 'AUDIO_DURATION_AT_PUBLISHED_RATE'::text])) AND (settled_at IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
